object: highest-grossing animated film as of November 20, 2023
belief: Frozen II (2019) was the highest-grossing animated film of all time as of November 20, 2023, with approximately $1.45 billion worldwide box office

author: worker_2
object: second highest-grossing animated film as of November 20, 2023
belief: The second highest-grossing animated film as of November 20, 2023 was Frozen II (2019) with $1,451,651,316 worldwide box office. The highest was The Lion King (2019) at $1,662,020,819.

author: worker_2
belief: Frozen II (2019) was directed by Chris Buck and Jennifer Lee.

object: third highest-grossing animated film as of November 20, 2023
belief: The third highest-grossing animated film as of November 20, 2023 was The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023) with $1,360,783,214 worldwide box office. The directors were Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic.
